Ethics statement: I paid full price. No one solicited my purchase or the review. No conflicts of interest.

The one I received does not have the lip at the top curved outward as pictured, so it does not pour as well as you might expect, but rather runs down the side.

The measurements are off by up to around 20% but not even consistently.

The measurements are also in stupid locations: The ounce scale is every 2 oz starting at 6 oz, but the metric scale starts at 180 ml and goes up by 60 ml each mark, except for the final one which is 40 ml. Would be much easier if the interval were fixed, and aligned with hundreds.

The measurement markings are also in stupid locations: the number is printed below the line, so by the time the milk comes up to the line, you have to infer what the line is by looking at the next one. Works better with transparent liquids, but I can't find a good source of transparent milk.
